post.summary: Cancel a job

Retry a failed/cancelled job under the same id. Re-reserves the job's estimate first — 402 insufficient_balance leaves the job terminal and untouched. The 402 body carries details { needed_cents, available_cents, reserved_cents, total_cents, held_jobs, job_id }: when total_cents >= needed_cents the credits are merely held by running jobs and a later retry will succeed; otherwise they are gone. Same details on a 402 from POST /v2/jobs (the cancelled row's id is job_id). 409 for a running job or one billed as part of a render tree.

Confirm gate of a multi-step pipeline job paused in awaiting_confirmation: { action: approve | retry | reject, overrides? }. The completed steps are billed at the pause and the rest of the hold is returned; approve/retry re-reserve the remaining steps' estimate — 402 insufficient_balance leaves the job paused (top up and confirm again). 409 when the job is not awaiting confirmation.
Re-run a FINISHED multi-step pipeline job from a later step as a NEW job: { step: "extend", overrides? }. Earlier steps are carried over (not re-generated, not re-billed). Returns the new job (202).

get.summary: Get the public price catalog

Get the public model catalog: every canonical model with its provider routes (exact model_key addresses, modality, priority, raw pricing rules, ops metadata). POST the canonical name for auto-routing or a route's model_key to pin it. ?tool= filters.

Browse reusable parameter values (ElevenLabs voices, Higgsfield/Recraft styles). Filter with ?type=, ?namespace=, ?tool= (what a given tool can use), ?q= (free text), and any metadata axis as a bare param (?gender=male&accent=british).
The filter vocabulary, derived from the rows: each metadata axis with its values and preset counts. ?type= scopes it (voices and styles have different axes).
One preset plus `tools` — the ready-to-merge fragment for each tool this preset can be delivered into, so you can build the request yourself instead of calling /apply.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The preset's id ('preset_a1b2c3d4e5f6').

post.summary: Merge presets into a request body. Send { payload, assets: ["preset_…"] }; the tool is inferred from payload.model. Returns the finished payload plus a per-preset report — unknown or incompatible presets are listed in `rejected` rather than aborting (422 only when nothing applied).

get.summary: Resolve account (userId, email) for render auth
List user API keys for the active account. Each key says whether it can be shown again (`revealable`), your `role` on it and how many people it is shared with (`shared_count`).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `shared` also returns keys other people shared with you (role `shared`, with their `owner`). Ignored with X-Team-Id.

post.summary: Create a user API key for the active account. The full key is returned once, in `api_key`; with `revealable: true` an encrypted copy is kept so it can be shown again and shared.
The full key, for keys created with `revealable: true` — to the key's managers and the people it is shared with. 409 `api_key_not_revealable` for keys that were shown once. Never cached.

get.summary: Who has the key: its `owner`, and the people it is shared with (`shares`). The key's managers only.

post.summary: Share the key with people by email. They see it in their key list (role `shared`), can reveal it when it is revealable, and can list the files it made; requests made with it bill the key's account. Emails with no varg account come back in `not_found`. At most 50 people per key; 30 requests per hour.

delete.summary: End someone's access to a key. Managers may remove anyone; you may remove yourself from a key shared with you.
